tutorials: A guide to setting up the Rogue Legacy 2 Archipelago randomizer.

v1.0.0.description:
First release

Core gameplay loop is all working, and completing an Archipelago run should feel relatively balanced.
v1.0.0.title: v1.0.0

v1.0.1.description:
### v1.0.1 
**Note: You will need both the new mod files and the new .apworld file if you update to this version**


Fixes a few issues related to traps:
- Traps now persist through biome transitions, including from the manor into the castle
- Traps now persist if the player returns to the main menu and then continues the run
- Traps now persist if the player closes the game and reconnects to the Archipelago
- Fixed automaton swarm and giant snowflake traps being swapped
- The dragon lancers should now actually appear in all biomes

Added config options for how likely an AP check is given when a chest is opened
- Added three options, one for each of bronze (normal), silver, and fairy chests.
- The defaults use the game's default odds of a drop occurring from each of these chests
  - 15% drop chance for bronze chests
  - 99% drop chance for silver chests
  - 100% drop chance for fairy chests

Fixed an issue where killing void beasts murmur and gongheads had their clear checks reversed

Changed the names of manor locations and items to be less wordy and cleaned up some logic around assigning the names.
v1.0.1.title: v1.0.1

v1.1.0.description:
**Note: Please replace both the .apworld and the game mod files when updating to this version**

Adds several soft-logic rules which reduces the early sphere bloating in previous versions. This should also help maintain a smoother progression. Each of these rules has an associated option that can be configured to change run progression.

1. manor_depths_per_boss - Determines how many manor purchases are considered to be "in-logic" at the current number of boss-kills
2. chest_pre_boss_percent - Determines how many chests in a given biome are "in-logic" before vs after a boss kill
3. stat_upgrades_per_boss - Determines how many (bundled) stat upgrades items need to be received for a boss kill to be considered "in-logic"
4. stat_upgrades_per_biome_tier - Same as above but for biome related checks like chests, journals, and memories

Also the config for locking the NPCs in their base-game manor purchase slots has been removed. Instead it is replaced with a new config: early_npc_unlocks (default: enabled)
When this setting is enabled, NPC unlocks are pressured to be earlier in the run by imposing them as logical requirements for later bosses and biomes.
v1.1.0.title: v1.1.0

v1.1.1.description:
**Note: Please replace both the .apworld and the game mod files when updating to this version**

### Improvements and new configs

- There's a new settings screen accessible from the pause menu for archipelago related settings
  - There's now an in-game toggle for death-link
  - There's a toggle to switch to a more minimalist item log that just displays plaintext in the top right of the screen instead of using the game's overlay banner
- Challenge room chests (the red portals) now reward you with a fairy chest location check for the biome you're in
- The starting class is now randomized (and if the knight isn't randomly rolled, it now becomes an item that can be discovered during the run)
- All explanation text for traits, relics, and spells are shown by default instead of the question marks the game normally shows for undiscovered items
- Blueprints and runes now only cost ore and red aether, respectively. This is to reserve gold exclusively for manor purchases (and teleporters)

### Bugfixes

- Receiving a death-link while in the manor, docks, or character select no longer softlocks the game
- Magnesis and lifesteal runes are no longer given by default when the enchantress is unlocked. They must be found as AP items
v1.1.1.title: v1.1.1

v1.1.2.description:
**Note: Only the game mod files (RL2Archipelago.zip) need to be replaced when updating to this version. If you already have v1.1.1 you can keep your .apworld**

### Improvements and cleanup

- The debug hotkeys (7- set boss clear flags, 8- give gold, 9- heal player, 0- reveal map) are now disabled by default. They can still be enabled in the AP settings screen, but they are not intended to be used during a real run.
- Added descriptions for the toggles in the AP settings screen
- Major improvements in how the mod handles a temporary disconnect from the AP server. Now the game should auto re-connect you when the server becomes available again.
  - The game will also show a notification to alert the player that they are disconnected
  - Progress can still be made while disconnected and it is saved even through the game being closed. It will re-sync with the server upon the next successful connection

### Bugfixes

- There was a rare issue where players would be unable to close a settings menu and after restarting their game would lose their progress. This has been fixed along with adding more robust save management so progress should not be lost anymore.
v1.1.2.title: v1.1.2

v1.1.3.description:
Note: Please replace both the .apworld and the game mod files when updating to this version

### Improvements

- Add a colored tree which displays the upgrade paths in the manor. Manor locations are now named according to this tree (i.e. Manor - Red Path Upgrade 3) so that it is much clearer what a hint (or spoiler log) is referring to in the manor.
  - This can be toggled on/off using the Spin-Kick button  
- Added flavor text for foreign item descriptions which indicates whether it is progression, useful, or filler (or trap). 
- Manor items are no longer all marked as progression, only stat upgrades (assuming the YAML is configured to require some number of stat upgrades before biomes/bosses are considered "in-logic") are now progression. Things like class unlocks are not. This should provide a marginal improvement in success rate when generating worlds with stringent logic.

### New Config Options

1. reveal_manor_upgrades - (true/false, default: false), When enabled, all upgrades in the manor will be shown so purchases can be planned in advance. The normal purchase gating still applies; before you can purchase an upgrade, you must have purchased the previous upgrade in the manor.
2. trap_appearance - (hidden/visible, default: hidden), When 'hidden' traps are disguised as another item from the multi-world so that they can't be trivially avoided by looking at an item name before purchasing. After purchase, the trap's true name is revealed. 

### Bugfixes

- Fixed a bug where in a specific scenario (all estuaries defeated and sun lantern received already) Johan would not spawn in Pishon Dry Lake to give the sun-lantern-conversation location check.
v1.1.3.title: v1.1.3

v1.2.0.description:
Note: Please replace both the .apworld and the game mod files when updating to this version

### New Features
- Added a new manor type using the YAML setting `manor_type` called "shop" which allows items to be purchased from the manor more like a re-stocking shop (very similar to Unfair Flips). There are 4 slots to buy from, and buying any item replaces it with a new item until that slot is exhausted. Items get more expensive the further into the shop you go. 
  - The idea is essentially to allow a larger number of purchases from the manor than the vanilla branching manor layout provides. With the shop layout you can have many more (or less) items available for purchase in the manor.
- Fabled weapons are now available in an AP run. They can be set to always be use-able, or can be unlocked as a progressive item for each class.
- Burdens are select-able for AP runs as well now. The first time you connect to an AP world, the burden selection screen will appear. This will set the burdens for the entire run. The only way to change them after this point is to enable the Debug Keys in the Archipelago Settings and press "6" to re-open that screen (which will take effect the next time an heir is selected). 
- Earning XP can now give you AP items. The in-game mastery rank can be set to earn items either per-class or as an overall mastery level. Mastery level is only increased when an heir dies (or retires) and at that point you will get earn the locations for these checks. 

### Improvements
- Allow controller input in the connection dialog box
- Changed YAML option `manor_depths_per_boss` to `manor_depth_percent_per_boss` to be more easily understandable, especially with the new manor type.
- Added an in-game tracker for biome specific checks (blueprint chests, rune chests, journals, and memories)
  - It will show you the number of checks you've collected, the number of in-logic checks, and the total number of checks available for each type. If all checks for a given type in a biome are out-of-logic, the whole row will be dimmed.
  - This can be toggled on or off in the Archipelago Settings screen
- Raised the limit on the maximum number of locations you can have for chests in the YAML options
- Checks which were already released from outside the game (via admin console or a player completing their game) will now be skipped for pooled checks (chests and individual-type journal/memories). This essentially means you don't waste locations on chests that would grant an item which is already given.

### New Config Options

1. `manor_layout` - (tree/shop, default: tree), Tree layout is the existing layout. It uses the same branching tree as the vanilla manor does. The new options is "shop" which gives the repeated slot purchase layout described above.
  a. `manor_shop_depth` - (1-100, default: 25), How many purchases each slot holds in the shop manor layout.
  b. `manor_depth_percent_per_boss` (0-100, default 25), what percentage of manor purchases are added to logic for each boss kill. This replaces the existing `manor_depth_per_boss` with a more easily usable setting.
2. `fabled_weapons` - (randomized/soul_shop/unlocked, default: randomized), Randomized turns the fabled weapons into AP items which can be received. They are progressive on the class unlock, so the first one received unlocks the class and the second instance will unlock the fabled weapon. When set to soul_shop, the fabled weapons are still purchase-able in the soul shop (and always available), although they use their normal price and are realistically probably difficult to afford. This is mostly the same as just turning them off. When set to unlocked, they will always be available so long as their class is unlocked.
3. `mastery_checks` - (disabled/total/per_class, default: total), Allows XP earnings to unlock Archipelago items. Each level of mastery rank counts as a single check. These can be totaled over all classes or give specific checks for each class's own mastery levels.
  a. `total_mastery_levels` - (1-750, default 50), How many checks are associated with mastery levels when in total mode
  b. `mastery_levels_per_class` - (1-50, default 10), How many checks for each class are associated with mastery levels when in per_class mode. This will result in 15 * mastery_levels_per_class number of locations being added
  c. `mastery_progression_percent` - (0-100, default 50), What percentage of the mastery level locations may actually have useful items behind them. This essentially allows you to tweak what percentage of the mastery levels you may be required to achieve, even though you can still have more checks afterwards that may give non-essential benefits.
  d. `mastery_xp_multiplier` - (10-10000, default 300), How much the XP you earn is multiplied before being converted into mastery ranks. 100 means you get the same amount of XP as the vanilla game awards, but that can be very slow. Turning this higher allows you to get more mastery ranks in less time. This becomes essentially required if you dial up the number of mastery-rank locations since later levels require a lot of XP. 

### Bugfixes

- More resilient save-handling. The sync between the AP server's state and the game's state should be stronger now. In addition, save recovery should be better. Archipelago runs now save backups similar the vanilla game runs and can restore them using vanilla's backup recovery screen. 
- Fixed a bug where stat upgrades weren't applied in specific scenarios mid-run (they instead waited until the next heir or certain triggers to apply).
v1.2.0.title: v1.2.0
